hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in *.compact) out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/contract" && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" compact compile --skip-zk src/lixi.compact src/managed/lixi 2>&1) || { printf "Compact compile failed after editing %s:
%s
" "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac
